faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking
faq.q1: How do I book an experience on BARQ?
faq.a1: Sign in with your phone number, browse experiences, choose your date, and confirm your booking — no password required.
faq.a2: Yes. Every provider is reviewed and approved by our team before they can publish an experience.
faq.a3: Yes, bookings can be cancelled before they're confirmed by the provider. Check your booking details for eligibility.
faq.a4: BARQ is available in Arabic, English, and several other languages, with full support in every language we offer.
